prompts.label: banner
prompts.text: Wide horizontal composition depicting a dynamic scene of floating lifestyle elements representing different dad archetypes: a sleek tech gadget glowing softly, a rugged multi-tool with outdoor gear, a chef's knife with subtle kitchen elements, and a cozy coffee setup, all arranged in an asymmetrical diagonal flow across the frame. Each element is stylized as a 3D cartoon object with subtle motion lines, connected by flowing abstract shapes and geometric patterns that create visual rhythm. The background features a soft gradient that transitions from warm teal to coral, with floating sparkles and decorative swirls that add movement without clutter. Modern flat illustration with soft 3D-style characters and objects, combined with subtle 2D decorative elements. Use warm, vibrant pastels (teal #00A99D, coral-orange #FF6B35, sunshine yellow #FFD700). Layout must be clean and giftable, using rounded forms, balanced negative space, and minimal visual clutter. The tone should feel cheerful, light, editorial, and creative — never realistic or photorealistic.

prompts.label: og
prompts.text: Centered composition featuring a stylized abstract representation of thoughtful gift-giving: a soft 3D cartoon heart shape at the center, surrounded by floating miniature icons representing different dad interests—a watch, a coffee cup, a hiking boot, a tool, and a book—all arranged in an organic circular pattern with gentle spacing. The elements float against a soft gradient background with subtle geometric patterns that radiate outward like gentle ripples. Decorative sparkles and abstract shapes create depth and movement, while maintaining a clean, focused composition. Modern flat illustration with soft 3D-style characters and objects, combined with subtle 2D decorative elements. Use warm, vibrant pastels (teal #00A99D, coral-orange #FF6B35, sunshine yellow #FFD700). Layout must be clean and giftable, using rounded forms, balanced negative space, and minimal visual clutter. The tone should feel cheerful, light, editorial, and creative — never realistic or photorealistic.
